title: Newspaper Article - Minutes Of S.M.C. Council Meetings Open To Press

page_data.en:
THE CHINA PRESS, SATURDAY, APRIL 26. 1930

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL C
C. I. D. REGIST
No. I. O. D. 1215
Date 30...4.. 30.

Minutes Of S.M.C.
Council Meetings
Open To Press

Notification Issued By
Secretary
Edwards

In spite of the defeat of the motion to allow Press representatives to attend Council meetings, this question has been thoroughly threshed out, and the secretary, Mr. S. M. Edwards, had despatched the following letter to the various newspapers affected, which provides means for the public and the press to obtain minutes of Council and Committee meetings forty-eight hours after such meetings.
The letter reads in full as follows:
Sir, At the Annual Meeting of Ratepayers held on April 16, it was decided that the minutes of Council Meetings and Committee Meetings as approved thereat by the Council shall be placed at the disposal of the Press as soon as possible after each Council Meeting, excluding only such portions as in the interests of the Ratepayers it may be considered undesirable to disclose.
I have accordingly to inform you that arrangements have been made to notify you of the dates upon which Council Meetings will be held in future, and that ordinarily the Minutes of such Meetings and of Committee Meetings confirmed thereat will be available for the information of your representative forty-eight hours after the meeting upon his calling at the Secretariat.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
S. M. Edwards.
Secretary.

《字林西报》，1930年4月26日，星期六

上海公共租界工部局
刑事侦缉处登记
编号 I. O. D. 1215
日期 30...4.. 30.

上海公共租界工部局
董事会会议记录
向新闻界公开

由秘书
爱德华兹
发布的通知

尽管允许新闻界代表出席董事会会议的动议遭到否决，但此问题已得到充分讨论，秘书 S. M. 爱德华兹先生已向各相关报社发出以下信函，其中规定了公众和新闻界在董事会及委员会会议召开四十八小时后获取会议记录的办法。
信函全文如下：
先生，在4月16日举行的纳税人年会上，决定将经董事会批准的董事会会议和委员会会议记录，在每次董事会会议后尽快提供给新闻界，仅排除那些出于纳税人利益考虑被认为不宜披露的部分。
因此，我特此通知您，已作出安排，将向您通报今后举行董事会会议的日期，并且通常情况下，此类会议及在会上确认的委员会会议的记录，将在会议结束四十八小时后，供贵报代表在前往秘书处查询时查阅。
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
S. M. 爱德华兹。
秘书。
